dataset: CNB LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index): official quarterly data - ARAD series with MPR snapshots, plus MPR/IR chart-data vintages (total + category contributions)
target_paper: CNB Working Paper 9/2026 (Blaha, Botka, Švéda, Michl), Table A6 rows 15-16: 'LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index): Total' and 'LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index): Wages and Labour costs'

series_mapping.LUCI_total: ARAD indicator MLUCLUTXXINDQ 'LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index): LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index), Index, Quarterly'; column labelled '*_LUCI' (MPR chart files) / 'LUCI' (IR chart files)
series_mapping.LUCI_wages_and_labour_costs: ARAD indicator MLUCLUWXXSTDQ 'LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index): LUCI -Wages and costs, Standard Deviation, Quarterly' (cs 'Mzdy a náklady'); column labelled '*_Mzdy_a_naklady' / '*_Wages_and_costs' (MPR) or 'Mzdy a náklady' / 'Wages and costs' (IR IV/2019 onward). It is the category CONTRIBUTION to LUCI in SD units (the 5 contributions sum to the total), named 'Wages and costs' by the CNB.
series_mapping.other_components: Employment MLUCLUEXXSTDQ, Unemployment MLUCLUUXXSTDQ, Demand for work MLUCLUDXXSTDQ, Rest/Other MLUCLURXXSTDQ

url_patterns.ARAD_data: POST https://www.cnb.cz/aradb/api/v13/indicators-data-by-codes?snList=<comma-separated snapshot ids, empty = latest baseline>&periodFrom=&periodTo=&roleId=U&type=single ; JSON body = array of indicator codes

arad_access_notes: ARAD placement: Monetary Policy Reports > Labour market > LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index); source 'Database of Monetary Policy Reports Data' (DPSZ). Snapshots = MPR vintages (baselines and scenarios) from Winter 2021 onward; Inflation Report vintages 2017-2020 are not in ARAD.

Access without an API key through the endpoints used by the public web app https://www.cnb.cz/arad/ (roleId=U): data via POST v13/indicators-data-by-codes with a JSON array of codes; indicator search via GET v13/search-results?string=luci&items=10&pageNo=1&type=I&roleId=U (type=S searches sets and returns nothing for LUCI).

Blocked or unsuccessful: https://www.cnb.cz/aradb/ root (HTTP 403 to curl, WebFetch and Firecrawl); a GET to v13/indicators-data-by-codes with a codes= query parameter returned the CNB 'Přístup byl zablokován' (access blocked) HTML page; legacy https://www.cnb.cz/docs/ARADY/HTML/index_en.htm is a 1.2 KB stub. The documented key-based ARAD API was not used.
Some English snapshot names in ARAD are mislabelled (e.g. id 90 'Winter 2026' is cs 'jaro 2026'; ids 14-16 'Autumn 2021' are cs 'jaro 2021'); vintages were mapped by the Czech names.
caveats: ARAD is the most likely source of the paper's series: the paper's labels share ARAD's base name 'LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index):' verbatim; 'Total' and 'Wages and Labour costs' are the paper's wording (ARAD: 'LUCI (Labour Utilisation Composite Index)' and 'LUCI -Wages and costs'). The paper names no source for these rows beyond footnote 13.

ARAD values are rounded to 2 decimals (so the 5 rounded components can miss the total by up to ~0.02); the MPR/IR xlsx chart files carry full precision. ARAD snapshots can start earlier than the xlsx chart window (see check_vs_mpr_xlsx).

'Wages and costs' / 'Mzdy a náklady' is the category CONTRIBUTION to LUCI in SD units, not a separately standardised sub-index: the five contributions sum to the total (max abs gap ~1e-14 in every xlsx file with that decomposition).

All MPR-era data (ARAD snapshots and MPR xlsx, 2021 onward) include the CNB forecast of LUCI to the end of the forecast horizon (latest vintage runs to IV/2028; grey forecast shading starts II/2026). Truncate before any real-time use. Forecast start was checked visually in 4 MPR PDFs (Autumn 2025, Winter/Spring/Summer 2026): forecast starts at publication quarter - 1. IR files (2017-2020) contain history only and end at publication quarter - 2 (checked for all 13).

Definition breaks: IR IV/2017 - IR III/2019 = first-generation LUCI (decomposition: vacancies / number of unemployed / number of employed / others; NO wages component). IR IV/2019 Box 2 'The extended LUCI' introduced the decomposition incl. 'Wages and costs'. MPR Autumn 2023 Box 3 'An updated LUCI computation method' (28 labour-market series per the box) revised the history heavily; see revisions_between_consecutive_vintages.

Displayed xlsx sample start differs by vintage: I/2002 (IR IV/2017 - III/2019), I/2000 (IR IV/2019 - MPR Spring 2024), I/2004 (MPR Summer 2024 - Spring 2025), I/2006 (MPR Summer 2025 onward). CNB WP 9/2026 uses May 2002 - Sep 2025.

CNB WP 9/2026 footnote 13 describes LUCI as built from twenty indicators (the 2017 description); the paper also X-13 seasonally adjusts all predictors and Chow-Lin interpolates LUCI to monthly. Only quarterly data are published; the paper's monthly series is not.

Units: standard deviations (IR subtitles: 'standard deviations from the long-term average'). The mean over the displayed history is not zero in later vintages (see history_stats per file), so the displayed window is not the standardisation sample.

File quirks: sheet name typo 'QUATERLY_DATA' in MPR Winter 2021 - Autumn 2022; Czech/English label rows swapped in MPR Winter 2021 (row 1 = English); chart numbering and column letters change every vintage (II_9 ... II_12; D_1 in the chartbook), so locate columns by label; IR period labels carry the year only on Q1 ('I/02', 'II', 'III', 'IV'); MPR labels 'Demand_for_work'/'Others' became 'Demand_for_labour'/'Other'.
Retrieval: plain HTTPS requests with curl and a browser User-Agent, no authentication; retrieved_utc is the client clock (UTC); the server's HTTP Date header is recorded where a header dump was kept.
search_attempts_without_luci_data: CNB forecast archive https://www.cnb.cz/export/sites/cnb/cs/menova-politika/.galleries/prognoza/predchozi_prognozy/forecast_26_mpr_summer.xlsx: sheets Inflation, GDP, 3M PRIBOR, CZK-EUR; no LUCI.
MPR Summer 2026 zomp_2026_leto_makroindikatory.xlsx and zomp_2026_leto_podkladova_data_boxy.xlsx: no cell containing 'LUCI'.

Box pages (IR IV/2017 'The LUCI - the labour utilisation composite index', IR IV/2019 'The extended LUCI', EN and CS; MPR Autumn 2023 'An updated LUCI computation method', EN): no xlsx/csv/zip links on the pages (charts are images); the data are in the report-level chart xlsx files listed above.
CNB WP 7/2024 'LUCI: Your Best Friend for Measuring Labor Market Tightness' page: the only file link is cnbwp_2024_07.pdf; no data or code links.
CNB blog 'Ukazatele napětí trhu práce jako lakmusový papírek stavu ekonomiky': charts cite the CNB forecast database (MPR Spring 2023); no download link.

Inflation Reports I/2017 - III/2017: no 'LUCI' header in any chapter II/III or box chart xlsx (LUCI first appears in IR IV/2017). The English IR IV/2019 page links only T_1_Makroindikatory.xlsx; the chart xlsx files are listed on the Czech pages with ?tab=tabgraph.
